cards.name: Scarstech Prologue
cards.text: There is nothing left. We are powerless. Their numbers stretch beyond sight, and their technology an incomprehensible nightmare surpasses everything we've ever known. With each passing moment, their core pulses with more energy, feeding them, making them stronger, while we wither. Our soldiers, broken and desperate, fight only to delay the inevitable, giving what little time they can to the terrified masses scrambling to hide. But even that is futile. The ships monstrous, unholy abominations are closing in. When they arrive, there will be no resistance, no salvation. This world, everything we loved, will be torn apart and consumed by these soulless machines. The Scarstech will inherit what remains, and all that was once ours will be ash in their wake.

Special Summon this card as an Effect Monster (Aqua/WATER/Level 6/ATK 500/DEF 2300) with the following effect (this card is also still a Trap), then, you can send 1 Level 4 or lower "Aquamarine" monster from your Deck to the GY, then banish 1 other "Aquamarine" monster from your GY. 
● Once per turn (Quick Effect): You can target 1 "Aquamarine" card in your GY; banish it.
You can only activate 1 "Aquamarine Seagrass Zostera" per turn.

cards.name: Aquamarine Coral Krait
cards.text:
1 Level 7 or higher "Aquamarine" Fusion Monster + 2 WATER monsters
(Quick Effect): You can target 1 face-up card on the field; send it to the GY. You can use this effect of "Aquamarine Coral Krait" a number of times per turn, up to the number of other Level 8 or higher "Aquamarine" Fusion Monsters you control. If this Fusion Summoned card leaves the field because of an opponent's card, while they control a non-WATER monster: You can Special Summon 1 "Aquamarine" Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, ignoring its Summoning conditions (This is treated as Fusion Summon.)

cards.name: Aquamarine Seafan Gorgonia
cards.text: During the Main Phase, if you control an "Aquamarine" monster (Quick Effect): You can Special Summon this card from your hand. If this card is Special Summoned: You can Set 1 "Aquamarine" Spell/Trap from your Deck. If this card is banish from your GY while you control an "Aquamarine" monster: You can add 1 "Aquamarine Aquasanctuary" from your Deck or GY to your hand, then discard 1 card. You can only use each effect of "Aquamarine Seafan Gorgonia" once per turn, also you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck for the rest of this turn, except "Aquamarine" monsters, the turn you activate any of these effects.

cards.name: Aquamarine Sand Clypeasteria
cards.text: During the Main Phase, if you control an "Aquamarine" monster (Quick Effect): You can Special Summon this card from your hand. If this card is Special Summoned: You can Fusion Summon 1 "Aquamarine" Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, by returning its Fusion Materials from your banishment to your GY. If this card is banished from your GY: You can banish 1 other "Aquamarine" card from your GY; Special Summon this card. You can only use each effect of "Aquamarine Sand Clypeasteria" once per turn.

cards.name: Aquamarine Aquasanctuary
cards.text: When this card is activated: You can add 1 "Aquamarine" card from your Deck to your hand, except "Aquamarine Aquasanctuary", then discard 1 card. While you control a Level 7 or higher "Aquamarine" Fusion Monster, your opponent’s monsters can only target them for attacks. Once per turn, if an "Aquamarine" Fusion Monster is Fusion Summoned to your field (except during the Damage Step): You can target 1 "Aquamarine" monster in your GY; Special Summon it. You can only activate 1 "Aquamarine Aquasanctuary" per turn.

cards.name: Aquamarine Bubble Colony
cards.text:
2+ "Aquamarine" monsters with different names
Must be either Fusion Summoned, or Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck) by banishing the above cards from your GY. You can only control 1 "Aquamarine Bubble Colony". Cannot be destroyed by battle while you control another "Aquamarine" monster. Your Level 7 or higher "Aquamarine" Fusion Monsters can attack a number of times each Battle Phase, up to the number of other Level 7 or higher "Aquamarine" Fusion Monsters you control with different names.
